originalTitle: United Airlines (UAL) Registers a Bigger Fall Than the Market: Important Facts to Note
summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, United Airlines (UAL) stood at $110.66, denoting a -3.95% move from the preceding trading day.
content:
United Airlines (UAL) ended the recent trading session at $110.66, demonstrating a -3.95% change from the preceding day's closing price. The stock's change was less than the S&P 500's daily loss of 0.76%. Elsewhere, the Dow lost 0.68%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq lost 1.13%.

The airline's stock has dropped by 1.87% in the past month, exceeding the Transportation sector's loss of 6.27% and lagging the S&P 500's gain of 1.26%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of United Airlines in its upcoming release. The company is forecasted to report an EPS of $3.01, showcasing a 8.27% upward movement from the corresponding quarter of the prior year. Meanwhile, the latest consensus estimate predicts the revenue to be $17.77 billion, indicating a 16.68% increase compared to the same quarter of the previous year.

For the annual period, the Zacks Consensus Estimates anticipate earnings of $9.91 per share and a revenue of $67.53 billion, signifying shifts of -6.69% and +14.32%, respectively, from the last year.

It is also important to note the recent changes to analyst estimates for United Airlines. These recent revisions tend to reflect the evolving nature of short-term business trends. As a result, we can interpret positive estimate revisions as a good sign for the business outlook.

Our research demonstrates that these adjustments in estimates directly associate with imminent stock price performance. To benefit from this, we have developed the Zacks Rank, a proprietary model which takes these estimate changes into account and provides an actionable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, spanning from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), boasts an impressive track record of outperformance, audited externally, with #1 ranked stocks yielding an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 4.53% lower. As of now, United Airlines holds a Zacks Rank of #4 (Sell).

In terms of valuation, United Airlines is currently trading at a Forward P/E ratio of 11.63. This valuation marks a discount compared to its industry average Forward P/E of 11.8.

It is also worth noting that UAL currently has a PEG ratio of 0.93. The PEG ratio bears resemblance to the frequently used P/E ratio, but this parameter also includes the company's expected earnings growth trajectory. The Transportation - Airline industry had an average PEG ratio of 0.93 as trading concluded yesterday.

The Transportation - Airline industry is part of the Transportation sector. This industry, currently bearing a Zacks Industry Rank of 226, finds itself in the bottom 9% echelons of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank is ordered from best to worst in terms of the average Zacks Rank of the individual companies within each of these sectors. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Keep in mind to rely on Zacks.com to watch all these stock-impacting metrics, and more, in the succeeding trading sessions.
